content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 unreserved temporary vacancies are available across three research positions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure they meet the post-specific educational qualification, research background, and age limits prior to submitting their applications. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PwD candidates as per Government of India rules. The notification does not specify a cutoff date for determining the age limit. rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, or a relevant plant science discipline, with thesis research focused primarily on CRISPR cas9 mediated gene editing, prime editing, transgenic generation, novel gene construct development, and evaluation of transgenic lines.
rows.desirable_qualification: Agrobacterium mediate genetic transformation in Soybean/Mustard/Pigeon pea, particle gun mediated transformation of plants, RNA mediated gene editing, Genome editing of plants, molecular cloning, Novel and efficient vector development, Molecular analysis of transgenic plants, Data interpretation and statistical analysis, Scientific writing.

rows.essential_qualification: Master’s degree in Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, Biotechnology, Plant Physiology, Plant Biochemistry, or Life Sciences, with a 4-year/5-year bachelor’s degree (1st Division). Candidates with a 3-year bachelor’s degree in basic sciences and a 2-year master’s degree must have NET/GATE/ICAR-SRF (PhD entrance) qualification and 2 years of research experience. Candidates with a 5-year B.Tech. + M.Tech. degree must have both qualifications mentioned on the degree. OR Ph.D. in any of the above disciplines.
rows.desirable_qualification: Agrobacterium mediate genetic transformation, molecular cloning, Molecular and physiological analysis of transgenic plants, data Analysis, Research paper writing.

rows.essential_qualification: Master’s degree in Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, Biotechnology, Plant Physiology, Plant Biochemistry, or Life Sciences.
rows.desirable_qualification: Agrobacterium mediate genetic transformation, molecular cloning, Molecular and physiological analysis of transgenic plants.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project end date. The initial appointment will be for six months or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. Extension of tenure is based on the satisfactory performance of the incumbent. Research Associate: Rs 61,000/- per month + 30% HRA for Master's degree holders; Rs 67,000/- per month + 30% HRA for Ph.D. holders. Senior Research Fellow: Rs 37,000/- per month + 30% HRA. If performance is non-satisfactory, he/she will be terminated from the post with one-month notice. Young Professional-II: Rs 42,000/- consolidated per month. There is no provision for re-engagement after the termination of the scheme, and selected fellows cannot claim regular appointment at ICAR-IARI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form link provided in the notification (https://forms.gle/fkohJ4DQj1RsspJE7 or https://forms.gle/Bb2WnJDbQszFtUpC7). Fill in all the required details accurately, ensuring that the project name and post applied for are correctly specified. Prepare your biodata neatly typed on separate white paper strictly adhering to the format provided in the application form (Annexure 1). Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph to the biodata form. Attach self-attested scanned copies of mark sheets and certificates from Class 10th Standard onwards (10th, 12th, UG, PG, Ph.D.), NET/GATE certificates, and proof of experience. Submit the completed online form and send the biodata along with all required scanned enclosures on or before 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Neatly typed and completed application form/biodata with self-attested passport-size photograph. Self-attested copies of 10th standard mark sheet and certificate. Self-attested copies of 12th standard mark sheet and certificate. Self-attested copies of Under-graduation (UG) degree and mark sheets. Self-attested copies of Post-graduation (PG) degree and mark sheets. Ph.D. degree certificate (if applicable). NET / GATE / ICAR-SRF qualification certificate (where applicable). Office orders for research experience, in addition to experience certificates issued by the Principal Investigators (PIs). Project work report/thesis, testimonials, and published research papers supporting research claims. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer, if currently working.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened after the last date of receipt. Only candidates possessing the essential and desirable qualifications will be shortlisted and called for an interview. The interview date and details will be communicated directly to the shortlisted candidates by email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Submission of incomplete applications or failure to properly specify the project and post name will lead to rejection. Candidates must fill in the marks obtained starting from 10th Standard to maximum qualification and attach relevant attested certificates, failing which the academic score will not be awarded. For more eligibility details, candidates may refer to ICAR OM No Edn./6/27/2014/HRD dated 13th July 2015, OM No Agril. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 unreserved temporary vacancies are available, consisting of 1 Research Associate (RA), 2 Senior Research Fellows (SRF), and 1 Young Professional-II (YP-II).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application and biodata is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The Research Associate post carries a monthly fellowship of Rs 61,000/- plus 30% HRA for Master’s degree holders and Rs 67,000/- plus 30% HRA for Ph.D. degree holders.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master’s degree in Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, Biotechnology, Plant Physiology, Plant Biochemistry, or Life Sciences with a 4/5-year Bachelor's degree (1st Division), or a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree with NET/GATE/ICAR-SRF and 2 years research experience, or a 5-year integrated B.Tech + M.Tech, or a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RA, SRF, and YP-II posts?
faq.answer: For RA and YP-II, the age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. For SRF, the age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, and PwD candidates as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances like HRA provided for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, 30% HRA is admissible on top of the monthly fellowship for the Research Associate and Senior Research Fellow posts, whereas Young Professional-II receives a consolidated salary of Rs 42,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates shortlisted and selected?
faq.answer: Applications are screened based on essential and desirable qualifications, and only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, the date of which will be communicated via email.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, all posts are purely temporary, contractual for an initial duration of six months or the project period, and co-terminus with the project scheme without any claim for regular appointment.
